### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
Explicit `type: aneos` and `eos-file`; default EOS remains `moist-mixture`.
An external implementation must replace the throwing weak symbols.
No tabulated accuracy is available from this tree.
:::

### Derivation

No thermodynamic model is shipped to derive. The wrapper defines the effective adiabatic index from the
external sound speed, pressure and density:
$$
\gamma=c_s^2\rho/p
$$ {#eq-ch02-aneos-gamma}

@eq-ch02-aneos-gamma is implemented by `cs` in [`aneos.cpp:40-45`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0/src/eos/aneos.cpp#L40-L45).
This is an interface identity, not a claim that the external material has constant heat capacity.
`aneos_check.py` checks the rearrangement only.

### Numerical method

`DU->PTL` supplies pressure, temperature and speed from density and internal energy density.
`DP->TUL` supplies temperature, internal energy and speed from density and pressure. `DT->PUL` handles
the temperature-floor request. All are cell-local external calls. No internal interpolation stencil is shipped.

### Limits

The shipped constructor throws. The wrapper lacks moist species and metric raising/lowering. It does not
implement `W->A`; callers must use `W->L` then `WL->A`. The base heat-capacity method returns zero.
No external ANEOS, wall, seam or forcing compatibility run is claimed.
Switch-combination coverage remains pending in @sec-ch12-matrix.
